answer_1.quote: Natural language generation (NLG) systems are increasingly expected to be naturalistic, contentful, and situation-aware due to their popularity and pervasiveness in human life . This is particularly relevant in dialogue systems , machine translation systems , story generation , and question answering systems ... We focus on two different document grounded generation tasks: (1) Wikipedia Update Generation task and (2) Dialogue response generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses/updates conditioned on context and document.

answer_2.quote: Following prior work , we evaluate our system-generated sentences against the reference sentences on Rouge-L , BLEU  and METEOR  metrics... Additionally, we present F1 which indicates the unigram overlap between the generated output and the reference sentence.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation was conducted on Amazon Mechanical Turk... We follow the human evaluation guidelines mentioned in ) and evaluate the system generated sentences on three dimensions: (1) closeness of the generated sentences to the references, (2) relevance of the generated sentences to the context and document, and (3) fluency of the generated sentences.
answer_4.guideline: Pick the option which is closest in meaning with the reference option; Pick the option which contains information from the document and fits the dialogue context coherently; Rate fluency on a scale of 1 to 4.
